hypothesis: Shortening loop history from 16 to 12 steps only after a learned pursuit bomb will retain at least 0.025 additional kills per multiplayer game without increasing paired loop counts or loop-game incidence. Blocking a further learned bomb after that intervention has already eliminated an opponent may reduce self-kills while retaining the kill gain.
changed_factor: Both arms keep the frozen checkpoint, t85 pursuit head, one-escape target geometry, no learned movement overrides, at most two learned bombs per round, and seven-step safe follow-up. Both shorten loop history only after a learned pursuit bomb. The postkill arm additionally blocks another learned bomb after the first learned intervention has been followed by an opponent elimination.
controls: Same checkpoint, learned artifact, attack gate, action mask, broad loop definition, scenarios, opponents, slots, evaluator, metrics, gates, and paired fresh seeds. No rewards, features, DQN weights, or learned pursuit parameters change.
selection: Among pilot-eligible arms, choose the largest kill gain, then score gain, lower self-kill increase, higher survival effect, lower paired loop-count increase, and finally threshold. Confirm once on fresh worlds; never promote automatically.

expected_cost.basis: Observed V17 and V18 throughput on this PC.
